text:
elaine: Heads-up: seeing ~120 leads in the last 30m that never hit a Sales owner — >1h SLA breaches. HubSpot enrichment failing and RR skipping some rounds. Anyone else?

sam: On it — can you paste a sample HS lead id and the raw error?

elaine: hs_lead_785334 — logs show `enrich_service 502` then `round_robin.assign null_owner`. Full snippet: `ERROR: enrichment timed out (502) -> routing returned no candidate`

ops-bot: alert: enrichment-service error rate spike (5xx) detected at 2026-03-21T10:02Z — incident INC-4572 created.

leo: We had a cert rotation yesterday for the enrich API clients, saw token expiry bursts. Could be retry config exposing the failures.

nina: Current HubSpot workflow blocks assignment until enrichment completes. If enrichment fails we return early and mark unassigned. Suggest change: fall back to lightweight attrs (country, product_interest) and continue RR. I can patch HS workflow. Example pseudo-workflow:
```
if enrichment.status == failed:
  set owner_pool = 'fallback'
  set enrichment_ttl = 15m
  proceed to assign
```

sam: I prefer a routing-service patch so we keep logic in one place. Plan: add `fallback_owner_pool` + flag `assign_on_partial_enrich=true`. Hotfix toggle: `/ff-toggle routing.fallback_on_enrich_fail on`. Also add metric emission for path.

aziz: Careful — fallback could skew assignments to EMEA SDRs if timezone not considered. We need a claim tiebreaker that prefers timezone-matched reps before RR.

elaine: Agree. Also request metric `lead.assign.path` with values `[full_enrich, partial_enrich, no_enrich]` and tag `owner_pool=fallback` so we can track SLA regressions.

sam: Will open PR in ~10m. Plan includes metric + `claim_tiebreaker` which prefers `region_match` then RR. Feature flag gated.

nina: I'll change HS workflow to stop blocking assignment and set enrichment wait TTL=15m. Will revert once routing patch is live. Ping me when PR merges.

deploy-bot: routing-service v1.18.4 -> canary (3 pods) started at 2026-03-21T10:27Z.

leo: After canary, can we run a synthetic test: create 10 leads with failing enrichment and confirm assignment < 2m?

sam: Test run complete: 10/10 assigned, avg 42s, path=partial_enrich. Rolling to 50% now, will 100% in 30m if stable. :thumbsup:

elaine: Thanks team. I'll write a short postmortem and update the SLA doc with a note: HubSpot enrichment timeout default -> 30s and routing fallback behavior.

sam: Added dashboard panel `assign.path` and alert when `no_enrich` > 5% of traffic for 15m.

elaine: closing loop — INC-4572 linked to PR 4123, HS workflow change 1894, and routing canary.
